verdict.rationale: Clara's docs claim the API gives 'programmatic control over every aspect of corporate spend management'. The docs back this with concrete endpoints for card creation, lock/unlock and deletion, card restrictions, transactions and labels, users, invoices, Pix payments, and webhooks, plus a published OpenAPI schema. However, there is no explicit UI-parity statement, and UI-marketed features such as expense reporting, approvals and Clara Intelligence insights have no documented API equivalents. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity guarantee, API coverage of approvals and expense-reporting workflows, API access to Clara Intelligence insights, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Clara API gives you programmatic control over every aspect of corporate spend management — issue and manage cards, retrieve transactions, handle users, process invoices
